title: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
abstract: arXiv:2611.24590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pre-trained models can read screens and reason about games, yet on an unfamiliar game, an agent still has to learn to play. We ask how an agent can self-improve on such a game from a few of its own attempts, in real-time visual games where the agent sees only the screen and the game keeps running while the agent thinks. We study two kinds of policy that can carry this improvement. In model as policy, a model selects actions during play; we adapt real-time chunking so that committed actions keep executing while the model reasons, and train a 2B controller for this interface. In code as policy, a model writes, tests, and revises a program between attempts, and the program acts during play. Across 170 GameWorld tasks, with at most eight one-minute executions per run, code as policy reaches 47.80% mean progress, against 30.90% for our trained controller, and leads in all five game categories. translated_title: 离线思考，实时行动：通过代码实现自我改进的视觉游戏智能体
translated_abstract: 预训练模型能够读取屏幕并对游戏进行推理，但在一个陌生的游戏中，智能体仍然需要学会如何游玩。我们探讨智能体如何仅凭少数几次自身尝试就在这样的游戏中实现自我改进，尤其是在实时视觉游戏中——智能体只能看到屏幕画面，且在其思考期间游戏仍在持续运行。我们研究了两种能够承载这种改进能力的策略形式。在“模型即策略”中，模型在对局过程中直接选择动作；我们适配了实时分块机制，使模型在推理时已提交的动作仍能持续执行，并为此接口训练了一个2B参数的控制器。在“代码即策略”中，模型在多次尝试之间编写、测试并修改程序，由该程序在对局过程中执行动作。在170个GameWorld任务上，每次运行最多进行8次一分钟的执行尝试，“代码即策略”达到了47.80%的平均进度，而我们训练的控制器为30.90%，且“代码即策略”在全部五个游戏类别中均处于领先地位。（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 在实时视觉游戏中，利用“代码即策略”——模型在尝试之间编写、测试并修改程序，由程序在对局中执行动作——智能体仅凭少量自身尝试即可实现自我改进，在170个GameWorld任务上取得47.80%的平均进度，显著优于“模型即策略”训练控制器的30.90%，并在全部五个游戏类别中领先。
en_tdlr: In real-time visual games, "code as policy"—where a model writes, tests, and revises a program between attempts that then acts during play—enables agents to self-improve from a few attempts, achieving 47.80% mean progress across 170 GameWorld tasks versus 30.90% for a trained model-as-policy controller and leading in all five game categories.
